_comment: Squatch gear on the walls, on the furniture, and printed on the things in the kitchen. Drop images into assets/art/ and point a slot at one. Slots without a file get a procedurally drawn placeholder. See README.md in this folder for the slot list.

art.title: The shield
art.caption: First thing you see every morning, whether you want to or not.

art.title: Swing or be swung
art.caption: Hung where you cannot avoid it. Some mornings it helps.

art.title: IEM Dallas 2022
art.caption: The first one. Nobody knew what they were doing and it did not matter.

art.title: The sweater
art.caption: Worth every penny. Worn exactly once.

art.title: GOOSKI
art.caption: Four Dews, two Taco Bells, one frag. The dream.

art.title: Under the lights
art.caption: IEM Dallas 2024. Six of you and about forty thousand watts.

art.title: Focus
art.caption: Somebody who takes this more seriously than you do.

art.title: The whole roster
art.caption: Somebody had to stand at the back. It is always the same somebody.

art.title: Five Years of Stacks
art.caption: The big one, over the couch. Five years. Nobody has left yet.

art.title: Jerseys on
art.caption: Everybody matching. Nobody warmed up.

art.title: Kit on, all of us
art.caption: One of the good ones. Everyone in frame, everyone still speaking.

art.title: The banner
art.caption: Came in a tube. Went up crooked. Stayed crooked.

art.title: The row
art.caption: Headsets on, nobody talking to anybody who is not in the game.

art.title: Somebody's basement
art.caption: Three hundred days of familiar. That is what the sign said, anyway.

art.title: The warbird
art.caption: Team shirt, someone else's aeroplane. Still counts.

art.title: Queueing at LOCALHOST
art.caption: Stuck to the door with a magnet. Downloading data, estimated 00:00 remaining. It was not.

art.title: Hung high
art.caption: Placed where you have to look up at it. That was the idea.

art.title: DreamHack
art.caption: Front row, cold pizza, everyone shouting at once.

art.title: Silver Sasquatches
art.caption: Hung at eye level, so it is the last thing you see before you queue.

art.title: Golf, allegedly
art.caption: Two hot dogs, one cart, zero holes played.

art.title: Dallas, after hours
art.caption: Matching tees, string lights, and nobody checking the time.

art.title: Thumbs up, all round
art.caption: Low on the fridge door, curling at one corner. Three of you and a tin of something.

art.title: Hawaiian shirt night
art.caption: There was a reason for this. It has not survived.

art.title: The bar after
art.caption: Stars and stripes on every shirt. Nobody planned that either.

art.title: IEM Dallas 2023
art.caption: MEGGY. BOOSHI. LOU. RIP. SHUBES. Names on the wall, where they belong.

art.title: Met the pros
art.caption: Dippin' Dots and a photo you have shown far too many people.

art.title: Denver 2026
art.caption: Big, by the door, so it is the last thing you look at before you don't leave.

art.title: The red zone
art.caption: He threw up in there.

art.title: On the tarmac
art.caption: Up near the ceiling, where it does no harm.

art.title: The foursome
art.caption: Four visors, one good swing between them. Above the cistern, obviously.

art.title: Chute on
art.caption: Over the mirror cabinet, for comparison purposes.

art.title: Austin Major 2025
art.caption: NUMBSKULL. BABS. ERICAN. MEGGY. BOOSKI. SAUCE. LOU. RIP. SHUBES. STOVE. APE. IRISH.

art.title: Stream banner
art.caption: Strung above the monitor, so it is in frame whether you go live or not.

art.title: The crest
art.caption: EST. 2021. Mounted above the shelf like a coat of arms, which it is.

art.title: The chain
art.caption: Framed, on the sideboard. No further comment offered.

art.title: The cave bar
art.caption: Five of you, one waterfall, and a drink somebody else paid for.

art.title: The dog
art.caption: The only one in any of these photos with their life in order.

art.title: Pride squatch
art.caption: Same silverback, better colours. Bedside, where it belongs.

art.title: Austin Major 2025
art.caption: Held on by one magnet, at an angle nobody has ever corrected.

art.title: Squatch Up
art.caption: Six milligrams. The warning is right there on the lid.

art.title: Berserker Brewing Co.
art.caption: Premium craft amber ale. Est. 2024. It is fine.

art.title: Jack AND Daniels
art.caption: Old No. 7. Sour mash. Both of them, apparently.

art.title: OrgaNick Pastures
art.caption: Regenerative organic pasture-raised. Eat those pasture raised eggs, folks.

art.title: Oops! All Lobbys Berries
art.caption: Sweetened balanced cereal. On top of the fridge, where cereal goes.

art.title: Tower sticker
art.caption: On the side panel, over the case badge it came with.

art.title: The old sticker
art.caption: Been on that door longer than he has lived here.

art.title: Austin jersey — front
art.caption: On the rail. Worn once.

art.title: Austin jersey — back
art.caption: On the rail next to its own front.

art.title: Booski at the podium
art.caption: The big one. Candles in front of it, door shut.

art.title: Booski, inspecting
art.caption: Propped beside it, smaller, tilted.

art.title: The beach one
art.caption: Between the front door and the Denver piece, on the last free wall.

art.title: The 2022 shield
art.caption: The old one. He prefers it and will tell you why.

art.title: IEM Dallas 2023
art.caption: Square crop, hung on the only bare wall left.

art.title: The cowboy portrait
art.caption: Face down under the bed, which is where you put a thing you cannot throw away.

art.title: IEM Dallas 2022
art.caption: The square crop. Hung after the big one, lower and a bit off.

art.title: The 2023 mark
art.caption: Small, high, over the shelf. You have to look up to notice it.

art.title: The newer one
art.caption: Went on later, at a different angle.

art.title: In the stands, Austin
art.caption: Somewhere in the second half. Nobody in this photograph is watching the game.

art.title: Hog Mama's Show
art.caption: Framed in Big Uncle Lou's office.
